infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SARJ Worldwide accesses your photo library so you can select an existing photo to use as your customer profile picture. For example, when you tap Edit Profile in the Account tab and choose Select from Library, we open your Photos so you can pick one image, which is then uploaded and displayed on your profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SARJ Worldwide saves a photo to your Photos library only when you take a new profile picture with the in-app camera and choose to keep a copy, so the image you uploaded to your customer account is also available in your Photos.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SARJ Worldwide uses the camera so you can take a new profile picture for your customer account. For example, when you tap Edit Profile in the Account tab and choose Take Photo, the camera opens so you can capture an image that is then uploaded and shown on your profile.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: SARJ Worldwide uses your location while the app is open. For customers, this auto-fills your pickup address when you tap Use My Location on the Book a Ride screen and shows your ride vehicle on the live map. For drivers, this sends your position to dispatch when you are online for a trip.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: SARJ Worldwide uses your location in the background only for drivers who are online with an accepted trip, so dispatch and the customer can track the vehicle on the live map until the trip ends. Background tracking is not used for customer accounts.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: SARJ Worldwide uses your location in the background only for drivers with an active accepted trip, so dispatch and the paired customer can see the vehicle on the live map until the trip is completed.

For example, when you tap Edit Profile in the Account tab and choose Select from Library, we open your Photos so you can pick one image, which is then uploaded and displayed on your profile.
